title: Harden lifecycle evidence guidance
scope: Expose the named release-gate --satisfy references in CLI help.
Reject missing, unsafe, or non-file repository artifact references before lifecycle transitions mutate canonical state while preserving normalized Evidence IDs and explicit non-path literals.
Publish an append-only erratum for the WI-0156 generated-view attribution and add a regression proving doctor and status --no-write do not change generated view bytes.
Run deterministic exact-candidate verification and Independent QA; perform no clean-room model rerun, publication, release, visibility change, purchase, reset, retry, or fallback.
acceptance_criteria: The close command help shows every named release-gate evidence requirement and a copyable --satisfy form.
Transition and close reject a nonexistent or unsafe repository artifact reference without changing the Work Item or event stream.
Existing normalized Evidence IDs, Git revision references, and explicit non-path lifecycle reasons remain compatible.
An append-only erratum correctly attributes the timestamp write to status without --no-write and preserves sealed WI-0156 evidence artifacts.
Automated regression proves doctor and status --no-write preserve generated capability-view bytes, and the full repository gate plus distinct Independent QA pass.

profile_assessment.rationale: Bounded local CLI guardrail, regression, and append-only evidence correction with no external release or model generation.
